kanami_code.meaning: Deterministic JANUS double-ended audit: start at the newest proof obligation, walk backward through provenance and barriers, then replay forward through exact dependencies; repeat until an audited fixed point adds no new method class or missing bridge.

status_legend.ACTIVE_EXACT: Already admitted theorem-bearing Keymaster operator or exact frontier theorem.
status_legend.EXACT_RESTRICTED: Exact theorem or algorithm in an explicitly certified restricted domain.
status_legend.BARRIER_NEGATIVE: Exact or formally scoped negative guard against an invalid universal inference.
status_legend.ALGEBRAIZED: Historical idea retained only through an exact theorem-bearing replacement.
status_legend.PRUNED: No P-vs-NP decision authority because operational selection was heuristic, random, scored or otherwise unproved.
status_legend.MISSED_EXACT_BRIDGE: Exact/restricted theorem present in corpus but omitted or too coarsely folded in the v1 atlas; not automatically activated.
status_legend.MISSED_BARRIER: Important negative guard present in corpus but hidden inside a coarse barrier bucket.
status_legend.HISTORICAL_EXACT_CANDIDATE_NEEDS_SOURCE_: Mathematically plausible exact primitive seen in historical lineage, but current branch needs immutable source/proof reattachment before admission.

kanami_spiral_passes.fixed_point_scope: Frozen 76-node manifest plus explicitly inspected current-branch C024/C025 theorem corpus and recorded historical reduction-signal lineage. This is not a claim of exhaustive mathematical knowledge or exhaustive search of every repository byte.

janus_missed_summary_ranked.why_it_matters: Branching, self-reduction, backdoor and action-graph methods all require restriction, yet the active typed algebra lacks a generic proof-carrying restriction morphism. Without it, cross-method composition is underspecified.

Intact-gate congruence already proves one nontrivial exact state merge beyond literal-swap orbits using current local functional context. It is a concrete seed for the present transition-equivalence gate.

The old quotient criterion already forbids hiding cost in discovery/proof/witness/state. The new frontier theorem should inherit this as a formal projection from the 9D ledger to Q_total rather than duplicate accounting informally.

Proof-carrying Davis-Putnam gives exact existential elimination and at most N accepted pivots. Its failure mode is state-size degree drift. This sharply redirects the universal theorem target toward polynomial canonical state/transition count and bounded cumulative bytes.
Some representation blow-up is merely dead computation history and can be removed exactly, but compression may transfer bytes into witness provenance. State-only metrics are therefore insufficient.

GT has a cheap recognizer plus deterministic cubic proof generator, demonstrating that exact family schemas can bypass generic search. A universal polynomial catalog-completeness theorem is still missing.

These exact local simplification ideas appeared historically but lack first-class current-branch proof contracts. Reattaching them prevents rediscovery and clarifies whether they compose with restriction and witness lifting.

Integrate the old Q_total criterion as a projection of the current nine-dimensional cost ledger. Only then test whether this equivalence class extends beyond literal-swap orbits with a polynomial canonical-state bound.
